# Fiam Pakistan

> Fiam Pakistan supplies commercial LED fixtures, LED modules (GU10/MR16/PAR/AR111), outdoor step lights, and decorative lighting panels for projects across Pakistan.

## Categories
- commercial-led-light — Commercial LED Light (linear, wall washer)
- fixtures-led-module — Fixtures LED Module / GU10 / MR16
- outdoor-light — Outdoor Light (IP65 step lights)
- decorative-lighting — Decorative Lighting (panels & accents)
